newsitem.title: DENMARK: Dollar, vaccine hopes boost Danish Novo.
newsitem.headline: Dollar, vaccine hopes boost Danish Novo.

text.p: Danish biotech group Novo Nordisk climbed around three percent on Tuesday, driven by rises in its New York-listed share, the strong dollar and the company's hopes to help develop a vaccine against diabetes.
At 1205 GMT the share stood at 651 crowns, 19.5 crowns up on Monday's Copenhagen close and 16 crowns higher than its finishing level in New York.
Novo research director Mads Krogsgaard said on Monday that the firm was working with American and other partners in the search for a vaccine but the project was "at a very early stage."
